procedural.name: weapon_recoil
procedural.rule: Use integer directional offsets from recoil_px; preserve fixed base; emit shot at actual gameplay event from current muzzle + recoil offset.

procedural.name: button_states
procedural.rule: normal / hover / pressed / disabled. Select state, never auto-cycle.
